title: Mindfulness, Sustainability and Social Change
description: Examines how mindfulness training, particularly meditation, is being integrated into contemporary environmental and social change efforts. Current research on the physical, psychological, ecological and social benefits of mindfulness training are examined. Students are introduced to a variety of meditative practices as part of the course.
notes: Credit will be granted for only one of ES 407, ES 480 (if taken in the same topic).

International students interested in this community-engaged learning course should contact the International Centre for Students (ICS) to discuss potential work authorization requirements for the experiential learning component of this course.
